seoTitle: How to Hide Candles in TradingView Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to hide candlesticks in TradingView, switch to a line or area chart type, and keep indicators visible for a clean analysis layout.
intro: Sometimes candlesticks get in the way when you want to focus purely on indicators, drawings, or a cleaner chart for a screenshot. This guide shows how to hide candles in TradingView, switch to alternative chart types, and bring them back whenever you need.

steps.heading: Hide candlesticks from chart settings
steps.body: Open the chart's style settings and toggle off the candlestick visibility to remove the price bars from view.

steps.heading: Switch to a line, area, or hollow chart type
steps.body: Instead of fully hiding candles, you can switch the chart type to a simpler style like line or area for a cleaner look.

steps.heading: Keep indicators visible
steps.body: Hiding candles doesn't remove your indicators — they'll continue to display on top of or below the now-empty price area.

steps.heading: Restore candles anytime
steps.body: Toggle the candlestick visibility back on from the same style settings whenever you want to return to the standard view.

faq.question: Why would I want to hide candles on a chart?
faq.answer: Traders often hide candles to focus purely on indicators, drawings, or trendlines, or to create a cleaner chart for presentations and screenshots.

faq.question: Does hiding candles delete my price data?
faq.answer: No, hiding candles is purely visual — your underlying price data and indicators remain intact and can be restored anytime.

faq.question: What's the difference between hiding candles and switching chart type?
faq.answer: Hiding candles removes the price visualization entirely, while switching chart type replaces candles with a different visual style like a line or area chart.

faq.question: Can I hide candles on mobile too?
faq.answer: Yes, the chart style settings with the candle visibility toggle are also available in the TradingView mobile app.
